id: title:Gilbert09:add action size region and invoice tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds account-wide ingestion of Droplet lifecycle actions, resource metadata, and invoice line items to the warehouse, establishing the necessary metadata and dependent lookups for billing attribution and resource-specific field resolution.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F4 is a cohesive group of three hunks. P1.F4.H4 adds account-wide state-transition action ingestion with account-level rate limits. P1.F4.H5 adds account-independent lookup endpoints for resource metadata. P1.F4.H6 adds invoice line item ingestion with dependent fan-out. These are substantive, bounded capability improvements to warehouse ingestion and metadata handling
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and metadata setup, but the actual runtime benefit, complete billing attribution, and customer adoption are not demonstrated or verified in this chunk. No tests or runtime behavior changes are supplied.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and configuration changes. No executable implementation, tests, or runtime behavior changes are supplied. No tier can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation change: checklist items marked complete.
observations.code_quote: - [x] `/v2/customers/my/invoices/{invoice_uuid} (invoice items) and /invoices/{invoice_uuid}/summary` — per-resource invoice line items; invoices are synced as headers only, so spend cannot be attributed to droplets or databases (high)
observations.posthog_connection: Adds documentation evidence that invoice and size lookup endpoints are now considered complete, but does not change ingestion, billing attribution or warehouse behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.
